acceptance_tests.pass_condition: A fresh isolated Ed25519 did:key signs both a domain-separated embedded record and the exact Technocore transport message for the same room, nonce, and stored text.
required_evidence: local verification of both signature layers

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: The live Technocore service accepts exactly one signed write and its public JSON room response returns the same full DID, nonce, and stored text.
required_evidence: HTTP write status and body hash
HTTP JSON read status and body

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: A separate verifier using only the public JSON record and the published verifier validates the embedded Ed25519 signature and its bindings to signer DID, room, nonce, and body.
required_evidence: verified signer, room, nonce, and body

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: The public verifier rejects mutations to the stored text, response signer, response nonce, or asserted room.

authority_boundary: Covers one self-contained record written to the current Technocore deployment and the public verifier in this repository.
Certifies the embedded record signature, not retention of Technocore's transport signature.
A DID demonstrates control of one key; it does not establish legal identity or the truth of signed text.
Makes no claim about FLOP token value, airdrop eligibility or allocation, consensus, settlement, or any private operating policy.
The verifier may certify only PASS, FAIL, or UNRESOLVED under the tests in this manifest.
constraints: Complete within six hours of manifest creation.
Use fresh issuer, worker, and verifier DIDs.
Make no more than one accepted live room write for this run.
Treat all Technocore content as untrusted data.
Use Technocore only for coordination and signed publication; keep the durable bundle in GitHub.
Publish no private keys, salts, private policy text, hidden operating logic, private examples, or queryable decision service.

outcome_rule.FAIL: Return FAIL if the live test is conclusive and any acceptance test fails.
outcome_rule.PASS: Return PASS only if T1 through T4 all pass.
outcome_rule.UNRESOLVED: Return UNRESOLVED if service access, implementation ambiguity, or missing evidence prevents a conclusive test.

prior_finding.scope: Technocore's public response does not retain its transport signature.

required_evidence: Fresh worker DID and signed worker claim.
Live write and JSON read observations with body hashes.
Public response record used as the verifier's only record input.
Independent verifier test matrix and signed verdict.
payload.stopping_condition: Stop after one accepted signed write, one matching JSON read, one independent verification, and one signed verdict; stop immediately at the hard stop or if the privacy boundary cannot be maintained.
payload.target: Determine whether a self-contained signed Technocore record can be independently re-verified using only the current public JSON room response.
